mapper.select: SELECT t1.ENUM_CODE , t2.ENUM_NAME , t1.ENUM_LABEL, t1.ENUM_VALUE, t1.ENUM_SORT , t1.PARAM1 , t1.PARAM2 , t1.PARAM3 from SYS_ML_MODEL_ENUM_ITEM t1 inner join SYS_ML_MODEL_ENUM t2 on t1.ENUM_CODE = t2.ENUM_CODE where t2.ENUM_VISIBLE = '1' AND t1.ENUM_CODE not in ('C0104','RX30011','RX30033','RX30034','908236ae299ab613d9d4aaee3b04d8ac','93dd2a06dc6dfc58077649e4ef64f8b0','543bed74050d47031a758ca3cc870213','RX16352','RX16467','RX98','RX16389','RX16351','C0108') and t1.ENUM_CODE not like '%RX%' order by t1.ENUM_SORT
